headline: Whole Milk Won A Game. It Was Against The Guy Who Runs This Website.
kicker: (85.48, league low, 0-13 in all-play. Anuj still went 1-1: the median sunk him by 1.41.)
lede: Anuj lost his first six head-to-head games. In Week 7 he drew Abhishek, who scored 85.48, the league low, with Trevor Lawrence on bye, a quarterback picked up at 6:26 on Tuesday morning and 34.86 points of running backs on his bench. Anuj won by 35.66, then missed the median by 1.41 and went 1-1 anyway. Barrett cleared it by 1.41 and is 7-0 against it. Will played a perfect lineup and lost by 1.62 to Nathan, who also played a perfect lineup. Greg (Miley) played his third perfect lineup in a row. Andrew scored 169.12 and benched the better quarterback for the second straight week, the other one this time. Maclane and Jon scored exactly 118.08 each. Chris is 14-0.

sections.awards: Fourteen citations. Three more perfect lineups, and two of them played each other.
sections.power: Season to date: record, points, all-play and this week's form, weighted, with movement from last week. Best lineup is the record each team would own if it had started its best legal lineup every week, everyone else exactly as they played. The tax is the difference: wins left on your own bench.
sections.median: Week 7's line was 122.55. Barrett made it by 1.41. Anuj missed it by 1.41, in the week he finally won a game. Will lost his game by 1.62 and got a win here anyway; Anuj won his and lost here. Maclane and Jon missed it by the same 4.47. Right of the line is a win.
sections.standings: Week 7 scoring, both results, and how much of your own roster you managed to start. Efficiency is what you scored over what your best legal lineup would have scored. Injured reserve does not count against you. Three teams hit 100.0 percent and went 2-0, 2-0 and 1-1.
sections.bench: 125.46 points of lineup regret this week, down from 126.46. One point of progress, league-wide, in a week. Nishil and Abhishek account for 51.32 of it.
sections.faab: Every dollar of Week 7, audited. $81 spent, 41 adds. Will spent $40 of it on a receiver he benched for 3.8. Nishil spent $16 on one who scored 21.0. Andrew added a Commanders receiver during the Commanders' bye. Twice.
sections.money: Auction dollars against everything each player has scored so far, started or not. A.J. Brown: $45, 14.6 points in seven weeks.
sections.studs: The best and worst starts of Week 7, measured against what Yahoo thought they would do. Nico Collins cost $43 and caught two balls for six yards.
sections.games: The long version, closest game first.

games.note: Two perfect lineups, one game. Nathan picked up Kirk Cousins on Thursday afternoon with Jayden Daniels on bye and got 20.4. Quinshon Judkins, who did not play a down for him last week, scored 22.9. CeeDee Lamb, two catches for nine yards in Week 5, caught two touchdowns. Wan'Dale Robinson ($0) scored 2.7 at flex and Pat Freiermuth, a Saturday pickup, 3.0 at tight end, and both were still the best available, because four of Nathan's five bench players scored zero. 136.72, 100.0 percent. Will matched him decision for decision: Joe Burrow started for 28.88 with Matthew Stafford's 18.5 on the bench, the first time Will has had two quarterbacks playing and started the better one. He paid $40 for DeMario Douglas, the biggest bid of the week, and benched him correctly for 3.8. KC Concepcion, 1.0 in Week 5, scored 20.2. The Jets defense, projected for 13.61, scored 3.7. 135.10, 100.0 percent, lost by 1.62. Will is finally on time and it did not help. The median saved him by 12.55. Five straight head-to-head losses, $10 of FAAB left.

Chris had Josh Allen on bye, so Tyler Shough started and scored 14.82. Tony Pollard scored three touchdowns at flex, 36.00 on a 13.37 projection, the best start of the week. Chris picked up Colby Parkinson at 11:22 on Saturday, benched him for 8.3 and started Jake Ferguson at tight end for 0.00. Xavier Hutchinson scored 13.36 on the bench. 86.6 percent, cleared the median by 1.95, 14-0, seven straight. Greg (IR) picked up Jacoby Brissett at 3:58 on Saturday afternoon, benched him for 16.48 and started Brock Purdy, who threw two interceptions for 14.02. Adonai Mitchell started at flex and scored 0.00, the league's most reliable zero, still reliable. Jalen Coker scored 1.4 at the other flex, with Dylan Sampson (9.2) and Jonah Coleman ($3, 7.9) on the bench. Greg's best lineup scores 135.52 and wins by 11.02. Blake Corum finally started and scored 16.6. Four straight losses, 37 moves.

Nishil filled his IDP slot this week. Alex Singleton, a $0 claim, scored 17.5 in it. Omar Cooper ($16) scored 21.0, Drake Maye 28.44, and Nishil won his first game against the median all season, by 7.93. Then the bench: Caleb Douglas, a Tuesday free agent, two catches, two touchdowns, 20.0, benched. Makai Lemon, picked up at 7:50 on Monday morning, benched, 16.2 that night. Roschon Johnson, who scored 13.5 on the bench last week, started this week and scored 1.3. 28.10 points of regret, the most in the league. Darrius played a 98.7 percent lineup and lost both games. Keenan Allen, benched for 7.0 and then 12.2, started at flex this week and scored 5.6. The Ravens allowed 35 and scored 3.18. Darrius has the third-most points in the league, a 6-8 record and the worst luck index in the league at -2.00.

Greg (Miley) played his third straight perfect lineup. Cam Skattebo went from 0.00 last week to 19.6. Javonte Williams ran for 155 yards, Trey McBride scored 23.1 and Nick Bolton, a Saturday pickup, 8.5 in the IDP slot. 137.06, 12-1 in all-play. Greg's best-lineup record is 11-3 and his real one is 6-8, because the first four weeks still count. Maclane scored 118.08. So did Jon, to the hundredth, in a different game. Both went 0-2 and both missed the median by 4.47. Maclane started Eddy Pineiro, a Friday pickup, with Cameron Dicker on bye: 3.0. He started the Colts (11.8) over the Vikings (12.16). Garrett Wilson scored 3.6. Tee Higgins scored 24.8 and it was nowhere near enough. The four-game winning streak is over.

Barrett cleared the median by 1.41, the smallest margin of the week, and is 7-0 against it. Kenneth Walker ($43) scored 7.7, Xavier Worthy 2.6 and Matthew Golden 6.9, while Devaughn Vele scored 13.9 on the bench. Braelon Allen, $1 in the auction, scored 17.4. 123.96 was enough because Tom scored 96.08, 1-12 in all-play, and missed the median by 26.47. Derrick Henry ($45) ran for 45 yards. Tom paid $11 for Kyler Murray and started him over Patrick Mahomes, correct by 6.90, and it did not matter. The house went 0-2 for the first time all season and its five-game head-to-head streak is over. Barrett is 13-1 and his best-lineup record is 14-0.

Six head-to-head games, six losses. Then Anuj drew Abhishek. Geno Smith scored 24.48, Rhamondre Stevenson 20.0, Tre Tucker 19.8, and Whole Milk won its first real game of the season by 35.66. Then it missed the median by 1.41 and went 1-1. Emmett Johnson: started for 5.4 last week with Jerry Jeudy's 8.9 on the bench, benched this week for 6.94 while MarShawn Lloyd started for 4.5. That swap alone clears the median. Abhishek scored 85.48, the league low, 0-13 in all-play, a week after a perfect 164.80. Trevor Lawrence was on bye, so Abhishek picked up Tanner McKee at 5:39 on Tuesday morning and J.J. McCarthy at 6:26, and McCarthy scored 10.18. Nico Collins ($43) caught two balls for six yards. Jaylin Noel, 22.38 last week, scored 1.98 at flex. Isaiah Likely 2.2. Dameon Pierce (12.78), Kaelon Black (11.76) and Tyrone Tracy (10.32) were all on the bench. Even the best lineup loses by 12.44.

Andrew scored 169.12, the high score of the week, 13-0 in all-play, and won by 51.04, the biggest margin of the week. He also benched the better quarterback for the second straight week. Week 6: Dak Prescott started for 13.02, Caleb Williams 16.5 on the bench. Week 7: Caleb started for 22.12, Dak 23.28 on the bench. Kyle Pitts scored 10.7 on the bench, his third straight week there: 12.7, 20.5, 10.7. On Saturday Andrew added Antonio Williams at 9:28, Makai Lemon at 12:26 and Antonio Williams again at 6:24. Antonio Williams plays for Washington, who were on bye. Lemon was gone by Monday morning and scored 16.2 that night on Nishil's bench. Jon started Bo Nix over Deshaun Watson, 26.28 to 19.22, the right quarterback two weeks running, and lost by 51.04. Dontayvion Wicks started at flex for 0.00. A.J. Brown ($45) scored 6.3 and has 14.6 points in seven weeks. 3-11, three straight losses, last in the power rankings.
